objective: Add a durable, staff-only pre-contract Lead follow-up lane to Today without changing construction ActionCard or frozen DailyBrief contracts.
implementation: Added append-only Lead follow-up records, one-open-row uniqueness, staff-assignment checks, opportunity lifecycle checks, and migration 0034 registration.
Added a separate typed pre-contract Today projection with overdue, due-today, and missing-next-action states, stable ordering, and truthful issued-Proposal wording.
Added admin/office-only Today, opportunity detail, schedule/replace, and completion API operations with idempotent retries and retained completion history.
Added the opportunity page with active admin/office assignment choices, scheduling, completion, and history; route changes suppress stale data and stale save results.

Today loads the opportunity lane only for admin/office users, avoids an all-clear claim until authorized coverage is loaded, and keeps lane errors scoped. The frozen Brief payload remains unchanged and its page names the follow-up coverage gap.

Proposal acceptance locks the same Lead row as follow-up writes and resolves any open follow-up inside the signing transaction, preventing a signed Lead from retaining open pre-contract work. Existing one-Job/Project and Proposal immutability behavior is retained.
